svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: Hybrid network on AWS
svg.desc: Hybrid network on AWS. 12 components in 9 groups. Connections: Application servers to Customer router; Customer router to AWS Direct Connect; AWS Direct Connect to Direct Connect gateway (transit VIF); Direct Connect gateway to AWS Transit Gateway (association); Customer router to AWS Site-to-Site VPN; AWS Site-to-Site VPN to AWS Transit Gateway (VPN attachment); AWS Transit Gateway to TGW attachment; TGW attachment to Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service; AWS Transit Gateway to TGW attachment; TGW attachment to Amazon EC2; AWS Transit Gateway to TGW attachment; TGW attachment to Amazon Route 53 Resolver.

text.tspan: A corporate data center reaches VPCs in three accounts in us-east-1 through one Transit Gateway, over Direct Connect with Site-to-Site VPN as backup
